observations: Two photos show a single wooden pallet on a concrete surface.
A third photo shows a large stack of identical wooden pallets in an industrial setting.
The pallets are made of light-colored wood with visible grain and knots.
The construction features two side blocks and a top deck with slats.
The wood shows signs of weathering and use, including darkened areas and some minor surface cracks.

claims.evidence: The items shown are standard wooden pallets with a deck board and side blocks.

risks.risk: Structural integrity of the side blocks and deck boards
risks.proof: A photo of the pallet under a load or a video of it being lifted.
A photo of the underside of the pallets.
A photo of the manufacturer's label or a specification sheet.

proof_requests: Photo of the underside of the pallets to check for rot or pests.
Photo of the manufacturer's label showing dimensions and weight capacity.
Photo of the pallets being lifted or stacked to verify structural strength.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as standard wooden pallets. While the condition is used and the exact specifications are unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a generic, potentially damaged unit.
